test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in the reported speech.

“What a wonderful ride it was!” said Madhav.

options.text: Madhav exclaimed that what a wonderful ride was it.
Madhav exclaimed that it was a wonderful ride.
Madhav exclaimed that what a wonderful ride it was.
Madhav asked was it a wonderful ride.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Madhav exclaimed that it was a wonderful ride."**
